overview.title: Artisanal Baking & French Pastry Arts
overview.text:
Baking is a science governed by weight, temperature, and chemical reactions. To succeed in the commercial baking sector, you must understand the physics of gluten development, yeast fermentation, and sugar crystallization. Culinary Academy's Pastry & Bakery Course in Dhaka offers a premium, hands-on path to master artisanal baking and French pastry arts.

From baking crusty baguettes and soft croissants to creating high-end multi-layered entremets, cheesecakes, and custom fondant decorations, our course covers the exact skills demanded by premium hotels and successful home bakers.

highlights.title: Baking Chemistry
highlights.description: Understanding flour types, hydration, and leaveners.

features: Hands-on practice using commercial deck ovens and spiral mixers
Learn advanced bread lamination techniques for croissants and puff pastries
Gourmet cake baking, slicing, filling, and sharp-edge frosting methods
HACCP-compliant raw material handling and baking hygiene standards
Mentorship under certified pastry chefs with years of hotel experience
Direct business coaching for launching a premium boutique bakery or home kitchen

faqs.question: What is the duration of the Pastry & Bakery Course in Dhaka?
faqs.answer: The Pastry and Bakery module is offered as a specialized track and is also included as a bonus within our Professional Chef Course.

faqs.question: Can I start a home bakery business after this course?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Many of our alumni have successfully launched profitable home bakeries in Dhaka, earning BDT 50,000+ per month.

faqs.question: Do you provide all baking ingredients?
faqs.answer: Yes. Culinary Academy covers the cost of all premium raw baking ingredients, baking kits, and recipes. There are no additional expenses.
